subject: RM_Meatvine
departures: made of raw, wet red-pink muscle tissue with visible fibre striations, not green stem or brown bark
anchored at both ends so it spans an arc between two fixed points, with no free growing tip
no leaves, flowers or curling tendrils anywhere along its length
visibly flexed or bunched like a contracting limb, with a half-formed, unfinished look along its length
glistening goo-like slick where it meets its anchors and across its surface
